mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_session WHERE FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM chat_turn WHERE session_id=#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler} AND status='completed' AND sequence > COALESCE((SELECT covered_sequence FROM conversation_summary WHERE session_id=#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}),0) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 10 ) recent ORDER BY sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_turn SET status='failed',error_message='上次生成已中断，请重新发送', completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id=#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler} AND status='pending'

UPDATE chat_session SET active_request=#{requestId,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}, locked_until=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '5 minutes', title=CASE WHEN title='新会话' THEN #{title} ELSE title END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler}

UPDATE chat_turn SET status='completed',assistant_content=#{answer.content}, model_name=#{answer.model},provider_name=#{answer.provider}, prompt_tokens=#{answer.usage.promptTokens},completion_tokens=#{answer.usage.completionTokens}, total_tokens=#{answer.usage.totalTokens},duration_millis=#{answer.durationMillis}, completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{requestId,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler} AND status='pending'
UPDATE chat_turn SET status='failed',error_message=#{error},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{requestId,typeHandler=com.febridge.persistence.UuidTypeHandler} AND status='pending'
